name: Silverwing Grove
summary: Silverwing Sentinels gather at Silverwing Grove in south-central Ashenvale, near Fallen Sky Lake. From this fortified hollow, night elf warriors muster Alliance forces against the Warsong Clan loggers cutting through the forest.

sections.title: Front Line of the Forest War
sections.body: At Silverwing Grove, Silverwing Sentinels gather beneath the canopy southwest of Silverwing Outpost. The night elves use the post to oppose the Horde's lumbering in Warsong Gulch. Alliance officers, provisions, and scouts assemble here to organize skirmishes and muster champions. They defend Ashenvale against orcish expansion.

faq.q: What is the purpose of Silverwing Grove?
faq.answer: Silverwing Grove is where the Silverwing Sentinels and their Alliance allies gather to oppose the Warsong Clan's logging and join the fighting in Warsong Gulch.
Silverwing Grove lies in south-central Ashenvale, southwest of Silverwing Outpost and just west of Fallen Sky Lake.

faq.q: Who operates out of Silverwing Grove?
faq.answer: Silverwing Sentinels and Alliance forces operate from the grove. Among them are an Alliance Brigadier General, logistical vendors, and officers such as Sentinel Farsong, who coordinates efforts against the Horde.

faq.q: Can Horde players enter Silverwing Grove?
aliases: can horde go to silverwing grove
faq.answer: No. Hostile Alliance sentinels and guards at the grove attack Horde members who approach.

angles.text: For the kaldorei, Silverwing Grove is a rallying place in their effort to stop the Warsong Clan from cutting down sacred trees.
Alliance champions gather at the grove before entering the bloody skirmishes of Warsong Gulch.
